source_text: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) in male infants under one year are 10- to 20-fold more common in uncircumcised boys, with incidence rates of 1-4% versus 0.1-0.2% in circumcised counterparts, per multiple cohort studies and systematic reviews; this disparity arises from bacterial ascension via the preputial orifice. [81] [82]
